patterns.what_worked: Priors-first (central ledger + three Forever desk journals + lessons) then targeted greps; every Forever API claim checked against origin/forever with explicit branch:path:line (the default checkout is classic_era, so the branch must be named). The operator clarifications arrived mid-audit and let the power-bar section be repaired before shipping: the pass-through path was verified from SimpleStatusBarAPIDocumentation.lua:229-232/355-358 and Blizzard_UnitFrame/Mainline/UnitFrame.lua:939-975, which corrected an earlier wrong 'passthrough unsupported' claim.
patterns.what_was_hard: The tree moved while the desk worked: the seven TOCs + main.lua went 2.1.7 -> 2.1.8 -> 2.2.0 (uncommitted) across parallel lanes, so every version field is reported as observed-at-time and no version claim is made. The secret restrictions are runtime state with no source-tree answer (C_Secrets predicates are documented but not instantiated), so the power-bar and stats-probe findings carry an explicit UNVERIFIED trigger list rather than a guessed cause.
patterns.skill_gap: None for this lane. Read-only desk work needs no extra tooling; the one repeated friction is that bench citations age (line numbers drift), so every inherited citation was re-read before use.
